notes.title: The Zombie Slayers – Demo Update Now Live!
notes.content:
We’ve rolled out a new update to The Zombie Slayers demo! Based on player feedback, we've made a number of changes to improve your experience.

The [b]Baby [/b]mechanic is now active in the demo! This tiny companion stays by your side, protects you, and occasionally demands milk with zero patience. Parenting meets survival !!!

🔧 Here’s what’s included:
[list]
[*]👶 [b]A baby added![/b] – [i]Yes, you read that right. A baby now follows and protects you loyally. But beware: when it gets tired, you'll need to feed it milk. No milk, no help.[/i]
[*]🎥 [b]Camera system updated[/b] – [i]The new camera is smoother and easier on the eyes. Prefer the old style? You can switch between both in the settings.[/i]
[*]🐞 [b]Bug fixes & better performance[/b] – [i]The game runs more fluidly thanks to core fixes.[/i]
[*]💬 [b]Improved onboarding[/b] – [i]New hints and clearer instructions help players get into the game more smoothly.[/i]
[*]🧍‍♂️🧑‍🤝‍🧑 [b]Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes separated[/b] – [i]More organized and streamlined mode selection.[/i]
[*]⚖️ [b]Gameplay rebalanced[/b] – [i]Combat and resource systems are now more fair and fun.[/i]
[*]🎮 [b]Usable items added[/b] – [i]You can now find and use new defensive and support gear to help you survive.[/i]
[*]🖥️ [b]UI polished[/b] – [i]Cleaner, sharper interface for a better overall experience.[/i]
[*]🎨 [b]Visual improvements[/b] – [i]Updated visuals add more atmosphere to the world.[/i]
[/list]

Try the updated demo now and let us know what you think! Don’t forget to Wishlist The Zombie Slayers and support the team.

💬 Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/UcGrfDssAN]Discord [/url]to share feedback, meet the community, and stay updated!
